title: Finish the Lava Chain
description: Use cobblestone decomposition, Mineral blending in a Reactor, Mineral melting in a Chemical Reactor, then Lava synthesis. The final Synthesizer is required to release 1,000 mB into a tank.
The full base cost is 192,000 FE. Heating stored material does not create a filled bucket by itself. Steam and condensation also use the Chemical Reactor; every complete route pays FE.
